assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: high-resolution original illustrated website background. Create one 3840x2160 landscape image, wide 16:9 composition. Original scenery with clear 2D hand-drawn pen outlines, simplified flat color shapes in distinct parallax layers and softly brushed atmospheric depth. NOT 3D, NOT photoreal, NOT thick impasto, NOT generic realistic fantasy concept art. Main cathedral architecture rises on right half: needle spires, narrow glowing blue windows, rib vaults, tiny hanging lamps, shallow stairway to a distant blue portal. Near-black midnight navy silhouettes frame the bottom and right edges, long curved roots and sparse grasses, middle distance in muted indigo and mist blue, a restrained icy cyan glow far behind arches. Uncluttered left 45 percent with quiet dark-blue haze and only faint distant silhouettes for readable UI later. Rich detail concentrated on the right, clean 2D contours and subtle painterly lighting, a quiet mysterious storybook atmosphere. No people, no characters, no faces, no creatures, no text, no logos, no UI, no watermark. Entirely new architecture and composition; do not copy any existing game screen or artwork.
